Since 0.1.13. The major version stays 0.

### Art
Moving between candidates in Y › Art fades only the art that changed. The wide art, the name card, and the L1 and R1 islands stay put. A new cover or logo leaves the wide art still. With no wide art, the backdrop is the cover, so that fades with the tile (#408).

### Home
All games with nothing in it says No games yet and offers Add games, as an empty collection does. Under that it names the way in: Find games in the folders Foldcade saw, or add a folder, and Sign in to RomM, or add a folder when none were seen. A, X, or a tap opens the same dialog as Home's Add games tile. The other screen says All games and 0 games. The tabs stay off while there is nothing to list. Up still reaches L1 and R1, and Down comes back to Add games. Cancelling RomM sign-in, the folder picker, or Settings returns to Add games, and an empty collection does the same (#409).

### Hints
The screen beside Themes names Themes, and the keys for the row you are on. Add a theme says A Open. Restart to see changes says A Restart. A theme you added says Remove on the bottom-screen button. One that comes with Foldcade says only B. While a theme is being added, that screen names no keys. The screen beside Licenses names Licenses. The D-pad says Scroll, and B goes back. A is left unnamed, since it does nothing on that page (#409).

While a Find result has the D-pad, the X, Y, and Start marks on Find's keys fade. X opens that game on the bottom screen, and Y opens Options (#409).

Two saves names the screen the choice is on. It says Choose a save on the top screen, or Choose a save on the bottom screen (#409).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
